name: sign-in
title: Sign in
description: Email and password sign-in with an optional passwordless / SSO row, forgot-password link and an error Notice.

frame.summary: A single centred column at form width. Not a Card: the auth template decides whether the column sits on a surface; the block itself is just the form.

regions.name: header
regions.purpose: Heading and one line ("New here? Create an account").

components.name: button
components.for: Submit (primary, `loading` while pending) and provider buttons (secondary).

components.name: divider
components.for: "or" rule between providers and the form.

components.name: notice
components.for: Credential error, variant danger, live="assertive" only on submit failure.

dependsOnFuture.interim: Providers region omitted until Divider exists, or the caller renders providers below the form without a separator.

headingLevel.summary: The outline level of "Sign in" (1 inside the auth template); everything below it steps down from here.
use: The level the surrounding page gives this block — a template passes it explicitly.
dont: Choosing a level for its visual size. Size is the Heading component's `role`, a separate decision.
headingLevel.a11y: No default, for the reason Heading's `level` has none: only the caller knows the depth, and a skipped level breaks heading navigation for the whole page.

onSubmit.summary: Receives credentials; reject with a message to show the error Notice.
onSubmit.type: (values: { email: string; password: string; remember: boolean }) => Promise<void>

providers.type: Array<{ label: string; icon?: LucideIcon; onSelect: () => void }>

signUpHref.summary: Where "Create an account" goes; omit for invite-only products.

behavior.summary: idle → submitting (submit Button `loading`, which is aria-disabled and stays focusable) → error (Notice above the fields, focus moved to it) or success (caller navigates).

decisions.decision: A failed sign-in moves focus to the error Notice
decisions.why: The reader pressed submit at the bottom of the form; the error is at the top. Without moving focus a screen-reader user hears nothing and a sighted keyboard user sees nothing change near them.

decisions.decision: The error never says which field was wrong
decisions.why: "Email or password is incorrect" — naming the field leaks which accounts exist.

decisions.decision: Fields are not disabled while submitting
decisions.why: Only the Button goes `loading`; disabling the fields would drop focus and, with native disabled, remove them from the form data — this system uses aria-disabled everywhere for that reason.

decisions.decision: Password reveal is not in this block
decisions.why: It needs a toggle inside TextField; that is a TextField feature request, not a block decision. Listed as an open question.

obligations: Providers' accessible names include the provider ("Continue with Google").

steps.change: Column fills the viewport less space.page.gutter.
Column capped at form width, centred by the template.

native.mapping: A single scrolling form screen. Fields map to platform text inputs with content-type hints so the OS password manager fills them; providers map to platform sign-in buttons (Sign in with Apple, Credential Manager).
native.ios: textContentType .username / .password; Sign in with Apple required if other social sign-in is offered.
native.android: autofillHints username/password; Credential Manager for passkeys.

tokens.forgot link placement: end-aligned under the password field, space.stack.2xs

openQuestions: Password show/hide: add to TextField (component change) or leave out?
Is magic-link / passkey-first a variant of this block or a separate block?
